make_dm_control_env: create a DM Control environment with frame stacking, action repeat, and extended time steps
create_action_repeat_wrapper: wrap a DM Control environment to repeat each action N times before returning the next step
create_frame_stack_wrapper: wrap a DM Control environment to stack multiple observation frames along the channel dimension
create_extended_timestep_wrapper: wrap a DM Control environment to return ExtendedTimeStep objects with action, reward, and discount fields
create_action_dtype_wrapper: wrap a DM Control environment to cast actions to a specified numpy dtype before stepping
